# Text editing controls

Text entry.

(api-gui-forms-textbox)=
## TextBox

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/text_box/text_box.hpp>
class TextBox final : public Panel
```

TextBox is a retained single-line Unicode editor with scalar-safe navigation, directional selection, clipboard/history commands, password projection, bounded user-input length, caret animation, semantic editing, and ordered text/selection events.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `TextBox`.

- Single-line editing uses scalar-safe navigation, directional selection, clipboard and history commands, password projection, a bounded user-input length, and caret animation.
- Multiline mode with `set_auto_scroll(true)` exposes the inherited `ScrollableControl` document scrollbars; explicit scrolling preserves text, selection, and undo history.
- Word wrapping suppresses horizontal overflow and measures against the space beside the vertical bar. Cached rows survive scrolling and unchanged paints.

(api-gui-forms-textselection)=
## TextSelection

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/text_box/text_box.hpp>
struct TextSelection final
```

TextSelection is TextBox's normalized byte-boundary selection value. It keeps anchor and active endpoints distinct while exposing ordered ranges for mutation and painting.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Utf8Offset start() const noexcept` | Returns the lesser UTF-8 byte boundary regardless of selection direction. |
| `Utf8Offset end() const noexcept` | Returns the greater UTF-8 byte boundary regardless of selection direction. |
| `std::size_t length() const noexcept` | Returns the selected byte count between normalized endpoints. |
| `bool empty() const noexcept` | Reports whether anchor and active endpoints identify the same insertion position. |

**Data members**

```cpp
Utf8Offset anchor{};
Utf8Offset caret{};
```
